normalized_text: Apollo 15 launched on July 26, 1971, from Kennedy Space Center. The crew included Commander David Scott, Command Module Pilot Alfred Worden, and Lunar Module Pilot James Irwin. The Saturn V third stage reignited to send them toward the Moon.
